The '''Banasthau system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="Slice" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Banasthaur]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="JediDawn" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Banasthau system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square O-11.<ref name="EAOC" />
